title: GeoLEON-CLIP: Graph-Anchored Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Geographic Region Representation
title_zh: GeoLEON-CLIP：面向地理区域表示的图锚定多模态对比学习

paragraphs.en: Geographic regions are naturally multimodal: satellite imagery captures visual morphology, textual descriptions encode human-interpretable semantics, and map-derived structures describe functional urban context. Existing geospatial contrastive learning methods often align image–text or image–location pairs, leaving structured map information underused. We introduce GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored multimodal contrastive framework for learning reusable geographic region representations. The model aligns three views of the same H3-indexed region: an OpenStreetMap-derived graph embedding, a satellite image crop, and a textual region description. The graph branch uses frozen pretrained LEON embeddings and, as we show empirically, acts as a semantic anchor between visual appearance and language. Frozen graph, image, and text encoders are connected through trainable residual projection heads and optimized with a symmetric tri-modal contrastive objective. Experiments show strong graph–image and graph–text alignment, with graph–image retrieval achieving the best cross-modal performance in the mixed-resolution pool. To test the anchoring hypothesis directly, we introduce chained cross-modal recall R ​ @ ​ A ​ @ ​ B \mathrm{R}@A@B , which routes retrieval through the graph modality and compares the result with direct retrieval at a matched candidate budget. In the strictest setting, R ​ @ ​ 1 ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{R}@1@1 , routing image → \rightarrow graph → \rightarrow text and text → \rightarrow graph → \rightarrow image is more accurate than direct image–text retrieval by 4.8 and 4.4 points respectively, even though the chain must commit to a single intermediate cell. Downstream probes show task-dependent gains, with the strongest improvements on Airbnb and Beijing housing. The results suggest that OSM-derived graph structure can serve as an effective anchor for multimodal geospatial representation learning that combines maps, imagery, and language.

However, adapting these representations to downstream geographic prediction tasks still often depends on scarce, spatially uneven, and task-specific labels, which remain a practical bottleneck for robust generalization across cities, administrative definitions, and spatial scales ( Boutayeb et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的地理空间基础模型与对比预训练方法表明，这类异构数据可用于学习可迁移的空间表示（Klemmer et al., 2025；Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023；Yan et al., 2024）。 然而，将这些表示适配到下游地理预测任务时，仍往往依赖于稀缺的、空间分布不均的、特定于任务的标签，这仍然是实现跨城市、跨行政定义和跨空间尺度稳健泛化的一个实际瓶颈（Boutayeb et al., 2025；Hao et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: This paper builds on LEON, a self-supervised graph masked autoencoder for urban region representation learning ( Sołtysiak et al., 2026 ) . LEON represents cities as H3-indexed graphs, connects neighboring H3 cells through spatial adjacency, and derives node features from OpenStreetMap amenity counts ( Uber Technologies, 2018 ; Sahr et al., 2003 ; Haklay and Weber, 2008 ; Hou et al., 2022 ; Veličković et al., 2018 ) . By reconstructing masked node attributes, the model learns embeddings that encode both local urban function and surrounding spatial context. Motivated by the strong graph-only representations obtained in this earlier work, we investigate whether the LEON embedding space can be extended from a unimodal graph representation into a shared multimodal geo-semantic space.
paragraphs.zh: 本文基于 LEON（Sołtysiak 等，2026）构建，LEON 是一个用于城市区域表征学习的自监督图掩码自编码器。 LEON 将城市表示为以 H3 索引的图，通过空间邻接关系连接相邻的 H3 单元，并根据 OpenStreetMap 设施数量推导节点特征（Uber Technologies, 2018；Sahr 等，2003；Haklay 和 Weber, 2008；Hou 等，2022；Veličković 等，2018）。 通过重建被掩码的节点属性，该模型学习到同时编码局部城市功能和周边空间上下文的嵌入。 受此前工作中获得的仅基于图的强大表征的启发，我们研究了能否将 LEON 嵌入空间从单模态图表征扩展为共享的多模态地理语义空间。

paragraphs.en: We propose GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored multimodal contrastive framework that aligns three views of the same H3 cell: an OpenStreetMap-derived graph embedding, a satellite image crop, and a textual region description. The architecture is intentionally modular. The graph branch uses the pretrained LEON encoder, the image branch uses a frozen visual foundation encoder, and the text branch uses a frozen multilingual embedding model. During alignment, only lightweight residual projection heads and the contrastive logit scale are trained. This design isolates the contribution of multimodal alignment while preserving the reusable structure learned by the graph encoder.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 GeoLEON-CLIP，这是一个图锚定的多模态对比框架，它对齐同一 H3 单元的三个视图：源自 OpenStreetMap 的图嵌入、卫星图像裁剪块以及文本区域描述。 该架构特意设计为模块化的。 图分支使用预训练的 LEON 编码器，图像分支使用冻结的视觉基础编码器，文本分支使用冻结的多语言嵌入模型。 在对齐过程中，只训练轻量级的残差投影头和对比 logit 缩放参数。 这种设计在保留图编码器所学可复用结构的同时，隔离了多模态对齐的贡献。

paragraphs.en: GeoLEON-CLIP targets a gap between graph-based urban representation learning and CLIP-style geospatial pretraining. Whereas prior contrastive models often align imagery with text, coordinates, or location encodings, our approach explicitly asks whether an OSM-derived graph representation can act as a bridge between visual morphology and human-readable place semantics. We evaluate this hypothesis through pairwise and chained cross-modal retrieval, modality-geometry analysis, projection-head ablations, and downstream spatial prediction probes. paragraphs.zh: 图锚定的多模态地理空间对齐。 我们提出 GeoLEON-CLIP，这是一种模块化架构，将源自 OSM 的图结构、卫星影像与文本化的地点语义对齐到共享的 H3 索引嵌入空间中。

paragraphs.en: H3-paired multimodal dataset construction. We describe a multi-scale dataset design over global metropolitan areas in which graph, image, and text views are paired through common H3 cell identifiers at district, neighborhood, and block scales.

paragraphs.en: Chained cross-modal recall. We introduce R ​ @ ​ A ​ @ ​ B \mathrm{R}@A@B , a budget-matched two-hop retrieval metric that measures how much of the image–text relation is recoverable by routing through the graph modality. It turns the informal notion of a “semantic anchor” into a falsifiable comparison against direct retrieval, isolates a regime, A = B = 1 A=B=1 , in which the detour through the graph is strictly better than the direct path, and includes alternative bridge placements as a control.
paragraphs.zh: 链式跨模态召回。 我们提出 R@A@B，这是一种预算匹配的两跳检索指标，用于衡量通过图模态进行路由时，图像—文本关系中有多少是可以被恢复的。 它将「语义锚点」这一非正式概念转化为可与直接检索进行对比的可证伪比较，分离出 A=B=1 这一情形——在该情形下经由图的绕行路径严格优于直接路径——并将其他桥接位置作为对照纳入其中。

paragraphs.en: Existing work has explored several forms of geospatial alignment, including image–location pretraining, image–text alignment for urban region profiling, and more recent multi-modal geospatial contrastive frameworks ( Klemmer et al., 2025 ; Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有工作已探索了多种地理空间对齐形式，包括图像–位置预训练、用于城市区域画像的图像–文本对齐，以及更近期的多模态地理空间对比框架 ( Klemmer et al., 2025 ; Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Spatial representation learning aims to encode places, regions, or grid cells into dense vectors that preserve functional, morphological, and contextual properties of geographic space ( Goodchild and Haining, 2004 ; Boutayeb et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Early urban prediction pipelines typically relied on hand-crafted GIS indicators such as POI densities, land-use proportions, road-network statistics, accessibility measures, and neighborhood aggregates ( Martí et al., 2022 ; Haklay and Weber, 2008 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 空间表征学习旨在将地点、区域或网格单元编码为稠密向量，以保留地理空间的功能、形态与上下文属性（ Goodchild and Haining, 2004 ; Boutayeb et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ）。 早期的城市预测流程通常依赖于手工设计的 GIS 指标，例如 POI 密度、土地利用比例、路网统计、可达性度量以及邻域聚合（ Martí et al., 2022 ; Haklay and Weber, 2008 ）。

paragraphs.en: More recent approaches learn region representations directly from spatial data sources, including volunteered geographic information, satellite imagery, mobility traces, and spatial graphs. H3 provides a practical hierarchical indexing system for representing geographic space as multi-resolution hexagonal cells ( Uber Technologies, 2018 ; Sahr et al., 2003 ) . Within this line of work, Hex2Vec learns context-aware embeddings of H3 cells from OpenStreetMap tags using a Skip-gram-style objective ( Woźniak and Szymański, 2021 ) , while S2Vec uses self-supervised masked autoencoding over rasterized built-environment features in S2 cells ( Choudhury et al., 2026 ) . These methods demonstrate that map-derived attributes can provide useful task-agnostic spatial representations, but they remain largely unimodal and do not explicitly align map structure with visual or textual views of the same region.
paragraphs.zh: 更近期的方法直接从空间数据源学习区域表示，包括志愿地理信息、卫星影像、出行轨迹和空间图。 H3 提供了一种实用的分层索引系统，可将地理空间表示为多分辨率的六边形网格（Uber Technologies, 2018；Sahr et al., 2003）。 在这一研究脉络中，Hex2Vec 使用类似 Skip-gram 的目标函数从 OpenStreetMap 标签中学习 H3 网格的上下文感知嵌入（Woźniak and Szymański, 2021），而 S2Vec 则对 S2 网格中栅格化的建成环境特征使用自监督的掩码自编码（Choudhury et al., 2026）。 这些方法表明，源自地图的属性可以提供有用的任务无关空间表示，但它们在很大程度上仍是单模态的，并未显式地将地图结构与同一区域的视觉或文本视图对齐。

paragraphs.en: Masked prediction has become a central self-supervised learning paradigm across language, vision, and graph learning. BERT introduced masked language modeling for bidirectional language representation learning ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) , while MAE showed that reconstructing masked image patches can scale effectively for visual representation learning ( He et al., 2022 ) . In graph learning, GAT introduced attention-based neighborhood aggregation ( Veličković et al., 2018 ) , and GraphMAE adapted the masked autoencoding principle to graphs by masking node attributes and reconstructing them from graph context using a scaled cosine error objective ( Hou et al., 2022 ) . LEON follows this line of work and instantiates graph masked autoencoding in a geographic setting: urban regions are represented as H3-indexed spatial graphs, edges encode cell adjacency, and node attributes are derived from OpenStreetMap features. This adaptation is important because geographic graphs differ from standard graph benchmarks: their edges correspond to physical proximity, node attributes are sparse and highly skewed, and nearby regions are strongly spatially autocorrelated.
paragraphs.zh: 掩码预测已成为涵盖语言、视觉和图学习领域的核心自监督学习范式。 BERT 引入了用于双向语言表示学习的掩码语言建模（Devlin et al., 2019），而 MAE 则表明重建被掩码的图像块可以有效地扩展到视觉表示学习（He et al., 2022）。 在图学习领域，GAT 引入了基于注意力的邻域聚合（Veličković et al., 2018），GraphMAE 则通过掩码节点属性并利用缩放余弦误差目标从图上下文中重建它们，将掩码自编码原理适配到图上（Hou et al., 2022）。 LEON 沿袭这一研究路线，并在地理场景中实例化图掩码自编码：城市区域被表示为基于 H3 索引的空间图，边编码单元格的邻接关系，节点属性则源自 OpenStreetMap 特征。 这一适配非常重要，因为地理图与标准图基准不同：其边对应于物理邻近性，节点属性稀疏且高度偏斜，并且相邻区域之间存在强烈的空间自相关。

paragraphs.en: Contrastive language-image pretraining has shown that large-scale image-text alignment can produce transferable visual representations ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . This idea has recently been adapted to remote sensing and geospatial representation learning. SatCLIP learns global location embeddings by contrastively aligning satellite imagery with geographic coordinates ( Klemmer et al., 2025 ) , while GeoCLIP aligns images with continuous GPS representations for worldwide geolocalization ( Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023 ) . RemoteCLIP and GeoRSCLIP specialize vision-language alignment for remote sensing by training or adapting CLIP-style models on remote-sensing image–text pairs ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . SkyScript constructs a large remote-sensing vision-language dataset by connecting unlabeled remote-sensing imagery with OpenStreetMap-derived semantic descriptions ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . UrbanCLIP is particularly relevant to urban representation learning because it uses generated textual descriptions to enhance satellite-image-based urban region profiling ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . These works demonstrate the value of contrastive alignment for geographic imagery and language, but most of them align either image–text, image–location, or image–caption pairs. Structured OSM-derived graph representations are usually absent or used indirectly as a source of textual semantics rather than as a dedicated modality.
paragraphs.zh: 对比语言-图像预训练已经表明，大规模的图像-文本对齐可以产生可迁移的视觉表示（ Radford et al., 2021 ）。 这一思想最近被应用于遥感与地理空间表示学习。 SatCLIP 通过对比对齐卫星影像与地理坐标来学习全局位置嵌入（ Klemmer et al., 2025 ），而 GeoCLIP 则将图像与连续的 GPS 表示对齐，以实现全球地理定位（ Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023 ）。 RemoteCLIP 和 GeoRSCLIP 通过在遥感图像-文本对上训练或适配 CLIP 风格的模型，将视觉-语言对齐专门化于遥感领域（ Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ）。 SkyScript 通过将无标注的遥感影像与源自 OpenStreetMap 的语义描述相连接，构建了一个大规模遥感视觉-语言数据集（ Wang et al., 2024 ）。 UrbanCLIP 与城市表示学习尤为相关，因为它利用生成的文本描述来增强基于卫星影像的城市区域画像（ Yan et al., 2024 ）。 这些工作展示了对比对齐在地理影像与语言方面的价值，但它们中的大多数只对齐图像-文本、图像-位置或图像-标题对。 结构化的 OSM 派生图表示通常是缺失的，或者仅被间接地用作文本语义的来源，而非作为一种专门的模态。

paragraphs.en: Recent foundation encoders make it possible to build modular multimodal systems without training every component from scratch. In computer vision, DINOv3 provides strong self-supervised visual backbones, including variants trained on large-scale satellite imagery ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . For text, multilingual embedding models such as Jina Embeddings V3 provide compact semantic representations across languages and tasks through task-specific low-rank adaptations ( Sturua et al., 2025 ) . GeoLEON-CLIP follows this modular design: the graph branch uses frozen pretrained LEON embeddings, while the image and text encoders are also frozen. Training is restricted to lightweight residual projection heads and the contrastive logit scale. This design isolates the alignment problem from full encoder pretraining and allows us to test whether graph-derived geographic structure can organize visual and textual semantics in a shared embedding space.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基座编码器使得构建模块化多模态系统成为可能，而无需从头训练每个组件。 在计算机视觉领域，DINOv3 提供了强大的自监督视觉骨干网络，包括在大规模卫星影像上训练的变体（ Siméoni et al., 2025 ）。 在文本方面，诸如 Jina Embeddings V3 这样的多语言嵌入模型通过任务特定的低秩适配，提供跨语言、跨任务的紧凑语义表示（ Sturua et al., 2025 ）。 GeoLEON-CLIP 遵循这种模块化设计：图分支使用冻结的预训练 LEON 嵌入，图像和文本编码器也处于冻结状态。 训练仅限于轻量级的残差投影头和对比 logit 缩放参数。 这一设计将对齐问题与完整的编码器预训练分离开来，使我们能够检验图衍生的地理结构能否在共享嵌入空间中组织视觉与文本语义。

sents.en: GeoLEON-CLIP follows this modular design: the graph branch uses frozen pretrained LEON embeddings, while the image and text encoders are also frozen.
sents.zh: GeoLEON-CLIP 遵循这种模块化设计：图分支使用冻结的预训练 LEON 嵌入，图像和文本编码器也处于冻结状态。

sents.en: Training is restricted to lightweight residual projection heads and the contrastive logit scale.
sents.zh: 训练仅限于轻量级的残差投影头和对比 logit 缩放参数。

sents.en: This design isolates the alignment problem from full encoder pretraining and allows us to test whether graph-derived geographic structure can organize visual and textual semantics in a shared embedding space.
sents.zh: 这一设计将对齐问题与完整的编码器预训练分离开来，使我们能够检验图衍生的地理结构能否在共享嵌入空间中组织视觉与文本语义。

paragraphs.en: Compared with spatial embedding methods such as Hex2Vec and S2Vec, our model is explicitly multimodal. Compared with remote-sensing vision-language models such as RemoteCLIP, GeoRSCLIP, SkyScript, and UrbanCLIP, our model introduces an explicit OSM-derived graph branch rather than relying only on images, text, or coordinates. Compared with location-image models such as SatCLIP and GeoCLIP, our method aligns region-level graph, image, and text views through a common H3 cell identifier. The central hypothesis is therefore not simply that multimodal pretraining helps geographic prediction, but that OSM-derived graph structure can act as a semantic anchor between overhead visual morphology and human-readable place descriptions. Table 8 in the appendix summarizes these differences side by side.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Hex2Vec 和 S2Vec 等空间嵌入方法相比，我们的模型是显式的多模态模型。 与 RemoteCLIP、GeoRSCLIP、SkyScript 和 UrbanCLIP 等遥感视觉-语言模型相比，我们的模型引入了显式的、源自 OSM 的图分支，而不仅仅依赖图像、文本或坐标。 与 SatCLIP 和 GeoCLIP 等位置-图像模型相比，我们的方法通过共同的 H3 单元标识符对齐区域级的图、图像和文本视图。 因此，核心假设并非简单地认为多模态预训练有助于地理预测，而是认为源自 OSM 的图结构可以作为俯视视觉形态与人类可读的地点描述之间的语义锚点。 附录中的表 8 对这些差异进行了并排总结。

paragraphs.en: The graph modality is derived from OpenStreetMap objects observed in the December 2025 snapshot. For each H3 cell, OSM objects are assigned to a single H3 anchor and aggregated into K = 31 K=31 functional categories. We use all OSM geometry types available for the selected categories. Point objects are assigned directly using their coordinates. For ways and relations, including polygonal geometries, we compute the geometric centroid and assign the object to the H3 cell containing that centroid. This centroid-based assignment ensures that each OSM object contributes to at most one H3 cell and prevents large polygons from dominating multiple neighboring cells. If a centroid lies exactly on the boundary between H3 cells, the object is assigned uniformly at random to one of the adjacent cells to avoid duplicate counting.
paragraphs.zh: 图模态来源于2025年12月快照中观测到的OpenStreetMap对象。 对于每个H3单元，OSM对象被分配到单一的H3锚点，并聚合为 K = 31 K=31 个功能类别。 我们使用所选类别可用的全部OSM几何类型。 点对象直接根据其坐标进行分配。 对于线和面要素（包括多边形几何），我们计算其几何质心，并将该对象分配到包含该质心的H3单元。 这种基于质心的分配方式确保每个OSM对象最多只归属于一个H3单元，并防止大型多边形主导多个相邻单元。 如果质心恰好位于H3单元之间的边界上，则将该对象随机均匀分配到相邻单元之一，以避免重复计数。

paragraphs.en: If an H3 crop overlaps multiple Sentinel-2 tiles or scene boundaries, we construct the image by mosaicking the available scene fragments. To avoid incomplete or visually truncated crops, we apply a simple histogram-based validation procedure that detects abrupt missing regions and abnormal intensity distributions. Crops failing this validation are replaced by the next-best candidate scene according to cloud coverage and temporal distance from December 2025. Digital values are converted to reflectance using the Sentinel-2 scale factor and then normalized with the channel statistics of the frozen visual encoder.

paragraphs.en: At resolution 9 9 the same mechanism yields a further benefit. A resolution-8 parent cell has seven resolution-9 children, and all seven fall inside the parent crop. Instead of encoding seven crops, we encode the parent once and read seven disjoint 2 × 2 2\times 2 windows from the resulting token grid: one at the center and six arranged around it. The assignment is geometric rather than arbitrary. We sort the seven children by their azimuth relative to the parent centroid and match that ordering to the azimuths of the six peripheral windows, so each window is registered to the child hexagon whose ground area it covers. A single forward pass therefore produces seven spatially registered child embeddings, which reduces encoder cost at the finest resolution by roughly a factor of seven and guarantees that sibling cells are described in a consistent visual context.

paragraphs.en: The text modality supplies place semantics that geometry alone does not expose and combines descriptions associated with OSM-derived objects with three complementary external sources. Wikipedia contributes encyclopedic descriptions of georeferenced places, Wikivoyage contributes travel-oriented accounts of urban areas, and Reddit contributes informal local discourse from city-specific communities.
paragraphs.zh: 文本模态提供了仅凭几何无法揭示的地点语义，并将与源自OSM的对象相关联的描述与三个互补的外部数据源相结合。 维基百科提供地理参照地点的百科式描述，维基导游提供面向城市地区的旅行类介绍，Reddit则提供来自城市特定社区的非正式本地讨论。

paragraphs.en: For each metropolitan area we query a regular grid of points with a 4 4 km step and a 5 5 km search radius, so that the overlapping circles cover large regions without relying on a single city-level query; Wikipedia and Wikivoyage results are then deduplicated by page identifier. From Wikipedia we keep the introductory plain-text summary and discard very short extracts. From Wikivoyage we keep the initial descriptive part of each guide, truncated before operational sections such as “Get in” or “Get around”, which retains the description of a place rather than lists of attractions and transport instructions. Reddit posts are usually not geotagged, so grid points are reverse-geocoded to city and neighborhood names, the corresponding city subreddit is queried by neighborhood name with a looser keyword fallback, and post titles with truncated self-text are retained. This source is noisier but captures colloquial place names, safety perceptions, nightlife, and housing discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个都会区，我们以4×4公里的步长和5×5公里的搜索半径查询规则网格点，使相互重叠的圆形区域覆盖大范围地区，而不依赖单一的城市级查询；随后按页面标识符对Wikipedia和Wikivoyage的结果进行去重。 对于Wikipedia，我们保留导言部分的纯文本摘要，并舍弃过短的摘录。 对于Wikivoyage，我们保留每篇指南开头的描述性部分，在“Get in”（抵达）或“Get around”（市内交通）等操作性章节之前截断，从而保留对一个地方的描述，而非景点清单和交通指引。 Reddit帖子通常没有地理标记，因此我们将网格点逆向地理编码为城市和社区名称，按社区名称并配合较宽松的关键词回退策略查询对应的城市subreddit，并保留帖子标题及截断后的正文。 这一数据源噪声更大，但能捕捉口语化的地名、安全感知、夜生活以及住房方面的讨论。

paragraphs.en: The three modalities are not perfectly simultaneous, which is unavoidable when combining map data, satellite imagery, and web text. We therefore define December 2025 as the primary temporal reference point. The graph modality uses the December 2025 OSM snapshot. paragraphs.en: The three pair losses have equal weight: the objective does not privilege graph-involved pairs. “Graph-anchored” instead describes the use of the pretrained LEON representation and the graph branch’s empirically observed bridge behavior. This role emerged from uniform tri-modal alignment rather than from an asymmetric loss designed to favor it. The inputs are nevertheless asymmetric in spatial context: LEON graph embeddings already incorporate neighborhood message passing and are further combined with parent/center/child context, the text branch uses the hierarchical parent/center/child context, and the image branch uses only the center-cell visual embedding. This asymmetry is a plausible contributor to the graph’s bridge role and to the weaker image–text alignment; extending the image branch with parent/child visual context is a natural direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: The reported base run trains for 10 10 epochs with batch size 1024, AdamW optimization, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} for projection heads, logit-scale learning rate 10 − 2 10^{-2} , 500 500 warmup steps, cosine decay, gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 , and exponential moving average weights for evaluation. During training, graph, text, and image are independently dropped with probabilities 0.10, 0.05, and 0.10; dropout is disabled at evaluation. We split 975,432 anchors once, with a fixed seed, into 877,889 training (90%) and 97,543 validation (10%) anchors, pooling all cities and resolutions and applying no spatial blocking. LEON was pretrained self-supervised on graphs from all 35 cities, without image or text supervision. All pairwise and chained retrieval results use one fixed 1024-anchor validation query/gallery pool and the same EMA checkpoint. Because the pool is sampled proportionally across the pooled resolutions, it is dominated by resolution 9 (about 85% of the sampled anchors). Ablation results reported below use the same validation protocol as the base checkpoint.

paragraphs.en: Pairwise retrieval establishes that the graph aligns well with both other modalities, but it does not test the anchoring claim itself. The claim is that the graph is a useful intermediate representation, and the direct way to test it is to force retrieval to pass through the graph and ask whether the detour costs anything. paragraphs.en: The retrieval experiments provide the clearest evidence for GeoLEON-CLIP. In the mixed-resolution pool, graph–image is strongest, graph–text follows, and text–image is weakest, but the per-resolution check shows that the first two can reverse order. The robust pattern is therefore that graph aligns strongly with both endpoints while direct image–text retrieval is consistently harder, supporting its use as an intermediate representation.
paragraphs.zh: 检索实验为 GeoLEON-CLIP 提供了最清晰的证据。 在混合分辨率池中，图–图像最强，图–文本次之，文本–图像最弱，但按分辨率的检查表明前两者可能颠倒顺序。 因此，稳健的模式是图与两端都高度对齐，而直接的图像–文本检索始终更难，这支持将其用作中间表示。

paragraphs.en: Chained recall turns that ordering into a stronger statement. A strictly single-candidate detour through graph is more accurate than direct image–text matching in both directions, while the alternative bridge placements that traverse the weaker image–text relation are substantially worse than direct endpoint retrieval. The R ​ @ ​ 1 ​ @ ​ 1 \mathrm{R}@1@1 result therefore suggests that the advantage occurs when the intermediate modality is strongly aligned with both endpoints. Its limited budget range is equally informative: as the candidate set grows, direct retrieval generally regains the advantage, so graph should be read as a high-precision bridge rather than a general replacement for direct retrieval.

paragraphs.en: The downstream probes are more nuanced. Adding embeddings improves several tasks, especially Airbnb and Beijing housing, but no single modality configuration dominates across all datasets: some tasks already have strong baseline features, and concatenating all modalities can introduce noise or redundant signal. paragraphs.en: Taken together, the results support graph-anchored multimodal learning as a direction for geospatial representation learning: an OSM-derived graph representation, trained without labels and kept frozen, can help organize satellite imagery and place descriptions in a shared H3-indexed space, with graph routing acting as a high-precision bridge whose observed margin varies with H3 resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这些结果支持将图锚定多模态学习作为地理空间表示学习的一个方向：由 OSM 导出的图表示，在无需标签训练并保持冻结的情况下，可以帮助将卫星影像与地点描述组织到一个共享的 H3 索引空间中，其中图路由充当一个高精度桥梁，其观察到的优势随 H3 分辨率而变化。

paragraphs.en: The dataset has several limitations. OSM coverage is geographically and socially uneven, textual sources vary across cities and languages, and the three modalities are only approximately aligned in time. The model is trained on precomputed image embeddings, so acquisition dates, cloud coverage, and mosaicking provenance are not exposed to it, and their effect on alignment is not analyzed. Text is also partly inherited across the H3 hierarchy: finer cells without directly assigned text use their parent-cell document, so sibling cells may share the same text view.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集存在若干局限性。 OSM 的覆盖在地理和社会层面都不均衡，文本来源因城市和语言而异，且三种模态在时间上只是近似对齐。 模型是在预先计算的图像嵌入上训练的，因此获取日期、云覆盖和镶嵌来源信息并未提供给模型，其对对齐的影响也未作分析。 文本在 H3 层级中也有部分是继承的：没有直接分配文本的更细单元格会使用其父单元格的文档，因此相邻兄弟单元格可能共享相同的文本视图。

paragraphs.en: The principal evaluation limitation is spatial generalization. The random anchor-level split contains all cities and resolutions in both partitions and uses no spatial blocking; together with graph-only LEON pretraining on all 35 cities, it can benefit from spatial autocorrelation and does not measure transfer to an unseen city. The mixed-resolution 1024-anchor pool is also slightly easier than separate within-resolution galleries for some image-side directions, so Table 3 should not be read as a pure single-scale difficulty estimate; equal gallery size does not imply equal difficulty across resolutions. We therefore treat the per-resolution results as a robustness check rather than a ranking of scales. Per-city, spatially blocked, and leave-city-out evaluation, multiple seeds, parent/child visual context, a CLS -versus-central-pooling ablation, and full-scale external-baseline adaptation remain future work.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的评估局限在于空间泛化。 随机锚点级划分在两个分区中都包含所有城市和分辨率，且未使用空间分块；结合在全部35个城市上仅使用图结构的LEON预训练，它可能受益于空间自相关，因而无法衡量向未见城市的迁移能力。 对于某些图像侧方向，混合分辨率的1024锚点池也比各自分辨率内的检索库稍显容易，因此不应将表3解读为纯粹的单尺度难度估计；检索库大小相同并不意味着跨分辨率的难度相同。 因此，我们将各分辨率的结果视为鲁棒性检查，而非对尺度的排序。 按城市划分、空间分块和留城评估、多随机种子、父/子视觉上下文、CLS池化与中心池化的消融对比，以及全规模的外部基线适配，仍有待未来工作完成。

paragraphs.zh: 案例1：图 + 文本 检索到图像图 北京 + 文本 圣保罗 ⇒ \Rightarrow 图像 圣保罗 h3:873181809ffffff 图像 图 文本“一个稀疏、未开发或纯住宅的区域，几乎没有记载的基础设施或商业活动。” + + h3:87a810000ffffff 图像 图 文本“所述城市区域拥有充满活力的氛围，其特点是多样的宗教场所和文化集会。” ⟹ \Longrightarrow h3:87a810146ffffff 图像 图 文本“一个稀疏、未开发或纯住宅的区域，几乎没有记载的基础设施或商业活动。” 案例2：图 + 图像 检索到文本 图 莫斯科 + 图像 东京 ⇒ \Rightarrow 文本 东京 h3:871181266ffffff 图像 图 文本“该城市区域的特点是多样的宗教场所和住宅物业，公共交通站点明显集中。” + + h3:872f5840bffffff 图像 图 文本“一个稀疏、未开发或纯住宅的区域，几乎没有记载的基础设施或商业活动。” ⟹ \Longrightarrow h3:872f5a48cffffff 图像 图 文本“该城市区域的特点是宗教场所、公共交通枢纽和自然绿地的融合，营造出独特的氛围。” 案例3：图像 + 文本 检索到图 图像 柏林 + 文本 上海 ⇒ \Rightarrow 图 上海 h3:871f18840ffffff 图像 图 文本“该城市区域拥有丰富多样的便利设施，反映出其多元的社区。 该区域坐落于两条主干道之间，拥有多家满足各种口味的场所。” + + h3:873098000ffffff 图像 图 文本“该城市区域拥有丰富多样的便利设施，体现其充满活力的特质，包括医院、学校和本地服务。” ⟹ \Longrightarrow h3:87309d0a2ffffff 图像 图 文本“该城市区域的特点是住宅与教育空间充满活力的混合，人口密度高。” 三个定性的跨模态算术示例。 每一行展示两个 H3 单元格用加号组合，以及蕴含箭头之后检索到的一个 H3 单元格。 每个 H3 单元格显示一张图像、一张图卡片和一段文本描述；操作数以细边框标出，检索输出以较粗的边框标出。
